summary: Blue Acquisition Corp. (a Cayman SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting a Fifth Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion Digital Infrastructure and Pubco. The amendment extends the Outside Date to November 30, 2026, indicating the deal has not closed by the prior deadline. The filing is an 8-K for a material definitive agreement; no terms, price, or premium are stated. The extension suggests ongoing uncertainty; if the outside date passes without closing, the SPAC may liquidate. Watch for further amendments or termination announcements.
